axes.proposal: Arabic text exists only in page files. Displayed string = render(span) = page slice at the resolved selector minus a closed deletion list (footnote markers, intra-span paragraph breaks). Sigla stay or the span ends before them. exact is a checked locator, never displayed. model:check asserts render(span) equals the slice minus listed markers for every span. A book's ayah quotation is shown as printed.

Statement under a Report (A) carries predicate, spans[], about[] and object as Mention ids reached only through Identification. Typed values split into parsed (machine-rederived, e.g. words-to-number) and classified (reviewed, span always shown). Statement.role maps ADR 0011. The profile is a derived view over published Statements, never an authored Assertion. Author voice needs a heading or frame span. Explicit-in-text heading identifications are bulk-reviewed.

Report has isnad span, matn spans and Chain = ordered elements (Link | Gap). Link: narrator Mention, mode parts SpanRef[], modeKey 1:1 with printed lemma+person/number, abbreviations (ثنا، أنا) keyed to the full form with the abbreviation span kept. jazm/tamrid is a derived class. Gap elements cover ta'liq, mursal, balagha, mubham, and no edge crosses one. Edition.riwayah chain, enclosedBy for quoted books, reported-anonymous voice for وقيل. An unmapped formula fails the check.
overrides: plannerB (gapBefore flag instead of Gap element)

axes.proposal: One global Entity per person. Every reference is a Mention. An Identification needs basis spans other than the mention: EDITOR_NOTE, RIJAL_ENTRY, or SAME_WORK_EXPLICIT (heading subject or يعني). Ambiguous isnad names never take explicit-in-text. With no basis, the mention stays unidentified text and gets no node. Competing sourced identifications are all DISPUTED. Reuse works per (mention form, neighbour) segment within a work, listing every application. NARRATED_FROM edges come only from reviewed identifications.
overrides: plan A's namaq-authored basis and labelled unreviewed edges

axes.proposal: Tradition + Membership over unmerged Reports. Basis is typed: same-origin-and-matn, editor-takhrij span, atraf-index span, or NAMAQ. NAMAQ groupings are allowed for history and athar, labelled 'grouped by Namaq'. Grouping a marfu' Prophetic report needs a takhrij, editor-note or atraf span until the owner relaxes it. Wordings are never merged, and a diff view is computed.
overrides: plannerA and plannerB (NAMAQ basis on marfu' by default)

axes.proposal: Per-record publication on minted ids. Revision hash = record fields + sha256(render(span)) + witness id for every span reached. A re-anchor with identical rendered text keeps the publication, and changed display lapses exactly the affected records, listed as 'published text moved'. Only the owner runs model:publish per change set. Publish and mark-reviewed stay separate acts.

Authored: data/works/<work>/(work, editions, witnesses, units/*.yaml), data/entities/, data/traditions/, data/glosses/ (English names, marked as ours), sources unchanged per edition. A change set (PR) lists record ids to publish. catalog/, batches/ and seeds are retired and archived under data/archive/pre-model. PG and Neo4j are derived. NARRATED_FROM edges live in a separate isnad view, are excluded from centrality, never cross a Gap, and carry modeKey+span ids. ADR supersedes 0010 layout.

Phase 0: ADRs and inventory. Phase 1: text core plus a span conversion of all citations. Phase 2: Siyar Statements with voice per report, plus the review surface. Phase 3: per-record publish. Phase 4: projection with the pre-model tag, dual tables for one release and a rollback criterion. Phase 5: Siyar chains. Phase 6: Bukhari kitab pilot with measured records and minutes per decision as a go/no-go. Phase 7: tafsir surah.

Shamela is the only host until the owner changes it. A Witness/Transcription records vowelled, footnotes and ligature insertion per volume range. Bare Sira v1-2 are shown with a fidelity flag. Edition identity = publisher+editors+printing, never publisher alone. ADRs name the Bukhari edition, the primary numbering with a mapping table for the others, and the Ayah mushaf/riwayah. Quoted ayat are shown as printed, the Ayah row linked, a difference flagged and never substituted.

Prophetic gate (P10): a statement whose origin is identified as the Prophet ﷺ needs a complete chain record with explicit Gaps, no default speaker, no LEGACY, honorifics as printed, and two independent reviews recorded by reviewer identity, at least one by a hadith-qualified person, not an agent. Other genres need one owner review. Identification review runs per segment. Costs per A 6.4 are re-measured in the pilot.
axes.dissent: I will not accept a merge that counts an agent as one of two Prophetic reviewers or drops the gate for the pilot.

axes.proposal: ADR 0008 holds: unreviewed statements are shown with their status. Legacy values show as 'no source yet' until promoted or retired. Exceptions for Prophetic material: no LEGACY, no NAMAQ grouping of marfu', and unidentified or unreviewed narrator mentions shown as text, never as edges. Text is never hidden; only unsupported links are withheld.

extras.rule_or_trigger: Before phase 6, record Shamela's terms for each work in an ADR; publish nothing derived until it is confirmed.
Search phase after projection: diacritic-insensitive index derived from rendered spans, built from the shared normalisation module, never stored as text.
A quiz question cites statement ids. A lapsed or changed cited statement unpublishes that question until it is re-reviewed.
A review record stores the reviewer identity and qualification. An agent is never a reviewer. Prophetic statements need two distinct humans, one hadith-qualified.
A Witness is flagged as a transcription, and Prophetic matn review compares against a printed page image when one is available, recording that it was checked.
Re-fetched text lapses exactly the records whose render changed. A normalisation version bump re-resolves all spans, and only changed renders lapse. Prophetic matn re-review needs the P10 gate.
Abbreviations map to the full modeKey with the span kept. Doubt and idraj words stay inside the matn span and are marked as insertions with a speaker.
At the Bukhari pilot, model each cut as its own Report with partial matn spans, grouped by Tradition. Never stitch.
An editor footnote grading is a grading Statement spoken by the editor Entity. Sigla such as (ع) stay as text and are not statements until a predicate exists.
Segment identifications are stored once and applied by reference. A check fails if two applications of one segment resolve differently.
Trigger: before the tafsir pilot (qira'at) and before phase 5 identifications (rijal work choice and ingestion order) are decided by ADR.
Resolution is batched by page and cached by page hash plus normalisation version. Projection tests cover disputed edges, Gaps and unreviewed identifications that produce no edge.
